text:
sara: FYI — AWQ int8 bakeoff failing on our cuda13 nodes. trt-llm plugin segfaults during forward. Repro on local h100-cuda13 container.

miguel: Can you paste the log?

sara: ```
[2026-03-19T14:12:03Z] trt-llm: forward() -> segfault (sig 11)
#0 0x7f6b2c1a1abc in _ZN6tensorrt...
#1 0x7f6b2c1a2def in trt::execute
#2 0x55a1b3c4d5e6 in run_inference

/opt/trt-llm/lib/libtrtllm.so.0.9.0
```

zane: Is this new since the cuda13 rollout or the trt-llm bump?

sara: Both overlapped — infra upgraded runtime images to CUDA 13 yesterday and we bumped trt-llm from 0.8.1 -> 0.9.0 in the model bundle.

keisha: Likely an ABI mismatch between driver / libcudart / trt libs. Can you share `nvidia-smi` and `ldd` of libtrtllm?

sara:```
$ nvidia-smi
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 535.54       Driver Version: 535.54       CUDA Version: 13.0     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

$ ldd /opt/trt-llm/lib/libtrtllm.so	
libcudart.so.12 => /usr/local/cuda-12/lib64/libcudart.so.12 (0x00007f6b2b000000)
libnvidia-ml.so.1 => /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnvidia-ml.so.1 (0x00007f6b2c600000)
```

miguel: Ah — container image points at cuda-13 headers but libtrtllm linked to cuda-12 runtime. That's our mismatch.

build-bot: CI: job bakeoff-awq-int8-cuda13 #2345 failed — test quant_inference_smoke (exit 139). Logs uploaded to artifacts.

miguel: Quick workaround to unblock testing: force fallback to non-TRT quant kernel. Try env `TRTL_DISABLE_AWQ_KERNEL=1` or run with `--runtime-fallback=gptq`

sara: Example run that avoids segfault (still slower):
```
docker run --gpus all -e TRTL_DISABLE_AWQ_KERNEL=1 \
  -v $(pwd)/model:/models/myawq:ro \
  redwood/bakeoff:cuda13-20260319 \
  ./bakeoff --model /models/myawq --quant awq --batch 4
```

zane: We should add a compatibility gate in model onboarding that verifies the linked CUDA runtime inside model bundle matches host driver/cuda. Also log which kernel path is chosen at startup (trt-llm vs vllm/gptq).

keisha: Filing infra ticket to test pinned driver 535.86.10 + cuda13 container with trt-llm 0.9.0. Some vendor fixes landed in that driver branch.

sara: I'll try re-linking libtrtllm against CUDA 13 in a dev image and post results tomorrow. Reproducer gist with steps + core dump attached in ticket.

miguel: Please also capture `ldconfig -p | grep libcudart` and a `readelf -d` on libtrtllm so we can see DT_NEEDED entries.

ops-jen: Heads up — pause cuda13 expansion for Dedicated pools running AWQ/INT8 workloads until we validate the full quant path. We'll pin current golden images.

sara: @ops-jen got it — will open a tracker and add to eng-runtime sync. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

keisha: For the record, fallback flag is an OK short-term workaround but we need an automated sanity check in the rollout pipeline. :eyes:

miguel: Agreed — I'll prototype a small `quant-compat-check` that runs ldd + a tiny inference to assert no segfault and kernel selection is deterministic.

sara: attaching the minimal reproducer steps here so it's easy to copy into CI:```
# repro steps
1. docker build -t repro-trtllm:cuda13 -f Dockerfile.cuda13 .
2. docker run --gpus all -e TRTL_DISABLE_AWQ_KERNEL=0 repro-trtllm:cuda13 /bin/bash -c "./repro --model awq --quant awq --batch 1"
3. if segfault -> collect core, `gdb -ex 'thread apply all bt' --batch ./repro core`
```

sara: Leaving this here so it's searchable. I'll update the ticket with pinned-driver test matrix and perf delta when fallback is on vs. trt kernel.
